items.Sentence: Influent wastewater undergoes screening (two influent channels) through bar screens, a.k.a. "aquascreens," prior to two parallel, aerated grit chambers.
Influent wastewater undergoes screening ... prior to two parallel, aerated grit chambers.
For flow equalization, influent wastewater can be diverted to Equalization Basin 3 (EQ3). During peak flow, primary effluent can be diverted to Equalization Basin 1 and/or 2 (EQ1, EQ2).
The facility has eight primary clarifiers. The primary clarifiers are equipped with helix skimmers that remove floating scum.

From the primary clarifiers, wastewater flow is split among 12 aerations basins. In November 2015, the Discharger completed equipment maintenance and upgrades to the air delivery system including a new diffuser system for more efficient cycling of anoxic and anaerobic conditions and larger air pipe headers for increased air delivery to the basins.
Wastewater in the mixed liquor channel flows to one of 10 secondary clarifiers for solids settling.

Waste activated sludge is pumped to a dissolved air flotation thickener (DAFT). Waste activated sludge from the sub-regional wastewater treatment plants and fats, oils, and greases (FOG) collected ... is trucked in and fed to one of two DAFTs.
The Facility employs two Aqua Diamond filtration units operated in parallel. The filtration units provide cloth media filtration and are equipped with a travelling bridge backwash component.
Remaining effluent is disinfected by the UV system and either delivered to recycled water users or discharged to the Mojave River.
Prior to UV disinfection, wastewater may be diverted to percolation ponds on-site that are regulated under Board Order No. R6V-2012-0058.
Thickened sludge from the DAFTs as well as sludge from primary treatment is pumped to five anaerobic digesters.
In 2015, the two sludge lagoons were lined. The sludge lagoons act as sludge thickeners.
From the digesters, sludge is pumped to two sludge lagoons, then is dewatered by gravity belt thickener, then transferred to soil-cement lined solar drying beds.
then transferred to soil-cement lined solar drying beds.
Polymer is added to sludge at the DAFTs for improved gas formation.
The thickened sludge, now called bio-solids, is applied off-site as a soil amendment for agricultural use.
